rachel.marketing: Small but urgent ask: marketing needs a mini sanity rerun for launch collateral. Can runtime run N=40 with quant profile q4_2-stable and fp16 baseline, 8k context? Need reliable p50/p95/p99 and a coldstart snapshot. cc @sam.runtime @toni.eng

sam.runtime: We can. Clarify artifacts: percentile table, cost/token estimate, coldstart heatmap, 15 anonymized raw traces, and run config? Any specific sample slices?

rachel.marketing: Yes to all. Use the "launch-samplepack-v2" and include the edge_long slice (seq_len>2500). Seed=12345. Keep prefix cache=on for main run, also include a cache=off coldstart slice (10 samples) with --warmup 0. Deliver CSV + JSON + PNG heatmap. Put artifacts in /share/marketing/benchpacks/1723456789/ and mark as embargoed. Deadline: Wednesday 10:00 PT.

toni.eng: We'll schedule. Note: our runner warmup default is 3 per host; we'll annotate that. Also we'll include delta columns vs baseline and basic bootstrap CIs for p95.

sam.runtime: Planned command:
```
enqueue-bench --cohort mini40 --seed 12345 --model redwood-alpha-8k --tokenizer rwd-tokenizer-v3 --variants "q4_2-stable,fp16" --context 8192 --cache on --tags marketing,launch,priority
```

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Job queued #3510 by sam.runtime  status: pending runners (https://rundashboard/jobs/3510)

sam.runtime: ETA 08:00 UTC tomorrow, expected wall time ~90m. If queue pressure, we'll run a prioritized 30-sample quick pass for the percentiles and heatmap and then backfill traces. Will ping when artifacts land.

rachel.marketing: Perfect. Please tag me in the artifact thread when uploaded. Thanks team! :rocket:
